svg.aria-label: Two small multiples from screening runs of 4 prompts on all 15 GPUs, gamingrig at idle clocks, one run per draft count. Left, columns of tokens per joule by drafts per step: plain 0.00798, 1 draft 0.01034, 2 drafts 0.01108, highlighted as the highest, 3 drafts 0.01096, 4 drafts 0.01060. Right, points for time per decode step: plain 228 ms, hollow and outside the fit, then 305, 374, 429 and 495 ms for 1 to 4 drafts, on a dashed least-squares line from 245 ms rising about 62 ms per extra draft. Point labels give tokens per step: 1.00, 1.85, 2.43, 2.72 and 3.01. Tokens per joule cover the 4-prompt window; step times and tokens per step cover all 5 requests, warm-up included.
